request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. 100 BPM, D Phrygian, 4/4. Muted low horns and bass trombone, cloth-muted field snare ghost notes, distant wordless low male choir. A solemn exhausted pilgrimage of the dead, lanterns in wind. Augment the motif into a slow horn ostinato, use E-flat as a dark Phrygian neighbour. Quiet march, never a bombastic military anthem; no literal wind effects. Sparse lyrical middle. Only wordless humming or vowel choir as specified; NO intelligible words, lyrics, speech or narration. Finish with texture and harmony compatible with the opening, no big final cadence, leaving a three-second editable overlap for a smooth game loop.
